Row.Text: Be at War with everyone in the Homelands.
War was an important part of Sengoku's identity.

War destroys, but it also creates. In the violence of recent conflicts – the “warring states,” or, in one of the tongues of the empire, Sengoku - comes a new philosophy of power – a simple one: who dares wins. Conventions of tradition, rules, order, law can be overthrown by a swift blade.
[B]Toyotomi Hideyoshi[/B] will convince you to play [B]Sengoku[/B] and was a unifier of [B]Sengoku Japan[/B].
